name: Item Price List With VAT
query:
SELECT
    ip.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:140",

    ip.reference AS "Reference:Link/Purchase Invoice:180",

    COALESCE(prev_ip.price_list_rate, 0) AS "Previous Selling Price:Currency:140",

    COALESCE(valuation.last_purchase_rate, 0) AS "Valuation Used:Currency:120",

    COALESCE(iclass.base_markup, 0) AS "Classification Markup:Float:120",

    COALESCE(ig.custom_base_markup, 0) AS "Group Markup:Float:120",

    COALESCE(icat.base_markup, 1) AS "Category Factor:Float:120",

    COALESCE(ipf.base_markup, 1) AS "Performance Factor:Float:120",

    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(iclass.base_markup,0) + COALESCE(ig.custom_base_markup,0))
        * COALESCE(icat.base_markup,1)
        * COALESCE(ipf.base_markup,1),
        4
    ) AS "Final Markup",

    COALESCE(icat.vat_rate, 0) AS "VAT Rate:Float:100",

    ip.price_list_rate AS "Price With VAT:Currency:140",

    ROUND(
        (
            (ip.price_list_rate / NULLIF(COALESCE(valuation.last_purchase_rate,1),0)) - 1
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS "Total Increase",

    ip.modified AS "Last Updated:Datetime:160"

FROM
    `tabItem Price` ip

INNER JOIN
    `tabItem` i ON i.name = ip.item_code

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem Classification` iclass ON iclass.name = i.custom_item_classification

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem Group` ig ON ig.name = i.item_group

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem Category` icat ON icat.name = i.custom_item_category

LEFT JOIN
    `tabProduct Performance` ipf ON ipf.name = i.custom_product_performance

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem Price` prev_ip
    ON prev_ip.item_code = ip.item_code
    AND prev_ip.price_list = ip.price_list
    AND prev_ip.modified < ip.modified

LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` valuation ON valuation.name = ip.item_code

WHERE
    ip.price_list = 'Standard Selling'

ORDER BY
    ip.modified DESC;
